mapper.insert: INSERT INTO instance_statistics () VALUES (#{instId},#{appId},#{hostId},#{ip},#{port},#{role},#{maxMemory},#{usedMemory},#{currItems},#{currConnections},#{misses},#{hits}, #{modifyTime},#{memFragmentationRatio},#{aofDelayedFsync},#{uptimeInSeconds}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE inst_id = #{instId}, app_id = #{appId}, host_id = #{hostId}, role = #{role}, max_memory = #{maxMemory}, used_memory = #{usedMemory}, curr_items = #{currItems}, curr_connections = #{currConnections}, misses = #{misses}, hits = #{hits}, modify_time = #{modifyTime}, mem_fragmentation_ratio = #{memFragmentationRatio}, aof_delayed_fsync = #{aofDelayedFsync}, uptime_in_seconds = #{uptimeInSeconds}
mapper.select: select statistic.id, info.id as inst_id, info.app_id, info.host_id, statistic.ip, statistic.port, statistic.role, statistic.max_memory, statistic.used_memory, statistic.curr_items, statistic.curr_connections, statistic.misses, statistic.hits, statistic.modify_time, statistic.mem_fragmentation_ratio, statistic.aof_delayed_fsync, statistic.uptime_in_seconds from instance_statistics statistic inner join instance_info info on statistic.ip = info.ip and statistic.port = info.port where info.app_id = #{appId}

SELECT count(statistic.id) instanceNum, sum(statistic.max_memory) applyMem, sum(statistic.used_memory) usedMem, sum(statistic.mem_fragmentation_ratio*statistic.used_memory) usedMemRss FROM instance_statistics statistic, instance_info info WHERE statistic.inst_id = info.id AND info.status = 1 AND statistic.ip = #{ip}
SELECT SUM(max_memory)/1024/1024/1024 totalMem,sum(used_memory)/1024/1024/1024 totalUsedMem from instance_statistics;
